name: fyrdwell
description: a Fyrdwell, a blonde elf archer with pointed ears in a green hood, a green-and-gold tunic and tabard, white fur cuffs and brown boots, a quiver of white-fletched arrows on his back, drawing a tall wooden longbow held out in his LEFT hand with an arrow nocked, riding a big spotted tawny stag with wide branching antlers, a white throat, a white tail and dark hooves
hands: the longbow stays in the rider's left hand held out on the screen-right side, and his right hand on the screen-left side draws the string back to his cheek
